headline: Executive session to discuss litigation strategy on the Garand Court Associates matter before the Appellate Tax Board.
summary: The meeting will go into executive session to discuss litigation strategy for matters scheduled at the Appellate Tax Board. The agenda states that discussing these matters in public would harm the litigation strategy.

Garand Court Associates matter before the Appellate Tax Board
location: City Hall – Room 9, 36 Court Street, Springfield, MA
plain_text:
Board of Assessors 
        36 Court Street 
     Springfield, MA 01103 
 
 
    
Regular Meeting – Friday November 6, 2026 9:30 AM City Hall – Room 9  
~Agenda~        Jessica Guerra - Chair 
413-886-5256 
 
 
I. Call to Order 
9:30 AM Meeting called to order on November 6, 2026 at City Hall – Room 9, 36 Court Street, Springfield, MA. 
 
 
II. Public Portion 
 
 
III. Executive Session 
The Board will vote to enter into Executive Session for the following reasons: 
 
1. ATB Docket Review 
  
Pursuant to M.G.L.ch 30A, section 21(3) the Board will enter into executive session to discuss the litigation strategy of matters currently 
scheduled at the Appellate Tax Board.  Discussion of these matters in an open public session will have a detrimental effect on the Board’s 
litigation strategy.  
 
A. ATB Docket Review 
 
The Board will enter into executive session and will not return to a public session for the following 
reasons:  
 
Pursuant to M.G.L.ch 30A, section 21(3) to discuss litigation strategy of matters currently 
scheduled at the Appellate Tax Board. Discussion of these matters in an open public session will 
have a detrimental effect on the Board's litigation strategy.
